text_block_list.text:
Since she fell asleep last time and wasn't
able to
play, I promise Haru that we'll
stop by the park
again on our way back
home.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! I'm gonna play lots and lots
today!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Let's see, what should we do first? The
curly slide
looks fun...
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
But the straight slide looks fun, too!
Okay, I'll try
that one first!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
She then scampers off toward the
playground.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ahaha! It's so fast! Again! Again!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! It feels like I'm in a tunnel!
Wheee!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Heehee! Haha! This is so fun!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you not gonna join me,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Come on! It's super fun!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
What?! You don't have to hold back
around me!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Oh! How about you choose what we try
next!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара
choice_data_list: All right... I choose the swings.

text_block_list.text: Swings?! Good choice! I love them too!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Then, let's compete to see who can
swing higher!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: HOOO! HAAAH! I! Won't! Lose!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Wuh, huh?! That's it, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
This swing set would probably snap if an
adult
went full force, so I hold back
quite a bit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, looks like today's victory goes to
me!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
But you did good too, Trainer! I could
see how
hard you tried! Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you the secret to winning next
time!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: What? Why?!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
You can still play even if you're not a
kid, y'know!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Mom and Dad would always go down
the slide
with me. It's okay!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: She pulls me to the slide.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Come on! Try it out! It's super-duper fun!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: WHOOOSH!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I slide down in the blink of an eye. It
feels
surprisingly nostalgic.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wow! That was great, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text: Okay! Here I come! Watch me, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
I politely decline her other attempts to
get me to
play and just watch as she
enjoys herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She taps her chest reassuringly. As we
head home,
I sense just how much she's
grown up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
